notes.title: Dev Update #3 | Tutorial scene
notes.notes:
This week we have completed the work on the tutorial scene, which will introduce you to the basic game mechanics. Every player should master it in a minute, so it won't delay you much.

We are currently working on dialogues for a story that you will be able to discover in the game.
We have also started work on a new level, we will be able to show you more next week.

notes.title: Dev Update #2 | Shy Eye Labyrinth
notes.notes:
Hello,
this week we started working on improving the green and red levels. They are a bit more challenging than the levels in the prototype. Also, some parts have been completely changed and the gameplay is a bit more interesting.
﻿
Another new feature is a simple tutorial level, which should be completed next week. It will explain the basic mechanisms of the game so that the player knows what the goal is in each level.

Below you can see some screenshots of the green and red levels.

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello,
we have some updates from this week for you. We are currently improving the original prototype of the Shy Eye Labyrinth game, which will be fully playable game available next month.
This week we worked mainly on improvements in the story, adding new features such as time challenges and integration with Steam scoreboard. The game will also fully support the controller.

In addition, we completely redesigned the opening scene and the first two levels (Purple and Yellow).
Below you can see some pictures from the opening scene and from the new levels.
